title: Elementor 4.3.0/4.3.1 (~2 million sites) has a CSRF flaw where one crafted link — clicked by a logged-in admin — creates a new administrator
content_md:
Elementor 4.3.0/4.3.1 (~2 million sites) has a CSRF flaw where one crafted link — clicked by a logged-in admin — creates a new administrator

via Mastodon https://www.cyber-defence.io/insights/elementor-csrf-flaw-one-click-site-takeover
